mechanism: Brimonidine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist that can cause systemic absorption leading to potential additive hypotensive effects with losartan's antihypertensive action.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly; brimonidine ophthalmic at recommended doses has minimal systemic absorption, but caution is warranted in patients with uncontrolled hypertension or those sensitive to blood pressure fluctuations.
